coc

Shukra Jaliya

2025-05-02

library(tidyverse)
library(openintro)
coc<-read_csv("coc_data.csv")

Exercise 1

total_population- count of people living in CoC poverty_rate -percent of people living below federal poverty line Overall Homeless -total homeless population in CoC Unsheltered Homeless- count of homeless not sleeping in space designated for or ordinarily used for sleeping Sheltered Total Homeless- count of homeless sleeping in shelter or shelter-like facility (publicly or privately funded/owned) funding_tot- funding total

#colnames(coc)

Exercise 2

coc <- coc %>%
  rename(
    total_homeless_count = `Overall Homeless`,
    unsheltered_homeless_count = `Unsheltered Homeless`,
    sheltered_homeless_count = `Sheltered Total Homeless`,
  )
coc$homeless_rate <- coc$total_homeless_count / coc$total_population
coc$funding_rate <- coc$funding_tot / coc$total_population
coc$unsheltered_rate <- coc$unsheltered_homeless_count / coc$total_population
coc$sheltered_rate <- coc$sheltered_homeless_count / coc$total_population

. HOMELESS RATE

#options(scipen = 999)
plot(funding_rate~homeless_rate + total_population, data = coc)

model <- lm(funding_rate~homeless_rate + total_population, data = coc)
summary(model)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = funding_rate ~ homeless_rate + total_population, 
##     data = coc)
## 
## Residuals:
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -199.28  -84.33  -39.76   40.78  771.07 
## 
## Coefficients:
##                    Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)       1.477e+02  8.874e+00  16.644  < 2e-16 ***
## homeless_rate    -1.276e+03  3.761e+02  -3.394 0.000764 ***
## total_population  2.379e-05  6.557e-06   3.629 0.000325 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 138.7 on 366 degrees of freedom
##   (5 observations deleted due to missingness)
## Multiple R-squared:  0.043,  Adjusted R-squared:  0.03777 
## F-statistic: 8.223 on 2 and 366 DF,  p-value: 0.0003212
coc$log_funding_rate <- log(coc$funding_rate + 1)
model_log <- lm(log_funding_rate ~ homeless_rate + total_population, data = coc)
summary(model_log)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = log_funding_rate ~ homeless_rate + total_population, 
##     data = coc)
## 
## Residuals:
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -3.7194 -0.4973 -0.0054  0.5190  2.1164 
## 
## Coefficients:
##                    Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)       4.716e+00  5.074e-02  92.933  < 2e-16 ***
## homeless_rate    -9.187e+00  2.150e+00  -4.272 2.47e-05 ***
## total_population  1.373e-07  3.749e-08   3.664 0.000286 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.7933 on 366 degrees of freedom
##   (5 observations deleted due to missingness)
## Multiple R-squared:  0.055,  Adjusted R-squared:  0.04983 
## F-statistic: 10.65 on 2 and 366 DF,  p-value: 3.194e-05
# Scatter plot for homeless_rate vs log_funding_rate
ggplot(coc, aes(x = homeless_rate, y = log_funding_rate)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Homeless Rate vs Log of Funding Rate", x = "Homeless Rate", y = "Log of Funding Rate")
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
## Warning: Removed 5 rows containing non-finite outside the scale range
## (`stat_smooth()`).
## Warning: Removed 5 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_point()`).

# Scatter plot for total_population vs log_funding_rate
ggplot(coc, aes(x = total_population, y = log_funding_rate)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "green") +
  labs(title = "Total Population vs Log of Funding Rate", x = "Total Population", y = "Log of Funding Rate")
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
